name: drafted
stderr:
Usage: drafted [options] [command]

Drafted CLI - Shared surface for AI-human collaboration

Options:
  --json                         Output as JSON
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                Authenticate with Drafted
  update [options]               Update the npm-installed Drafted MCP daemon
  logout                         Sign out and clear stored credentials
  start [options]                Start Drafted server
  stop                           Stop Drafted server
  status                         Check the Drafted server this CLI talks to,
                                 and whether you are signed in
  url                            Get canvas URL
  create-project [options]       Create new project
  use-project|project <id>       Set active project
  projects [options]             List the projects you can access (read-only)
  layers [options]               List frame layers — the built-in set, or a
                                 project's own with --project
  types                          List window types and device presets
  add [options] <source>         Add frame (upload file or URL to server)
  ls|list [options] [path]       List layers, lanes, or frames in a project
                                 (read-only)
  read|get [options] <pathOrId>  Read a frame's content (HTML/text/markdown),
                                 or binary metadata, by path / frame URL / ID
                                 (read-only)
  asset                          Project asset operations (read-only)
  remove <id>                    (deprecated) Use MCP tools: rm
  clear                          (deprecated)
  mcp-config                     Print MCP server configuration for Claude
                                 Desktop
  google-setup                   Let your local agent read your Gmail, Drive
                                 and Calendar (read-only, via Google's gws CLI
                                 and your own Cloud project)
  mail-watch [options]           Check your connected email threads for replies
                                 (runs every 5 minutes once installed)
  setup [options]                Register Drafted MCP server with Claude Code
  skill                          Skill library operations
  minion                         Minion management (checklist-driven intake
                                 surfaces). Requires the agent allowlist.
  repo                           Registered git repos (org index of .agents/
                                 skills/identities and .wiki/ pages)
  help [command]                 display help for command
